v.deps: Needs the backend API in EP-57107 (split from this story, Exhibitor team, Oleksii Tur): a new days-with-sessions endpoint and a day-range calendar endpoint. The backend change was breaking and left the calendar broken on alpha until this frontend reached rc on 23 Sep, so releases had to be agreed with the frontend developer. Parent epic EP-57118. Description split: FE 4d (Zakablukov), BE 3d (Tur), QA 3d (Khromei).
v.impact: Attendees: fast, frictionless browsing between days with clear visual cues showing which dates have scheduled content. Organizers: higher session discovery and agenda engagement across multi-day schedules.
v.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.
v.rationale: Essential navigation improvement for multi-day events. Provides an intuitive horizontal date strip with active session day indicators and ensures attendee date selections persist across page navigations.
v.why: DLG: turn the session Week View into a 3-column Multi-day View that hides empty days and time slots and loads days in chunks.
